name: core.openwop.workflows.campaign-autonomy
description: Campaign Studio autonomy policy (ADR 0942 D7): the daily digest of notify-after steps. One chain per workspace, scheduled host-side when a client or campaign policy asks for a daily digest. It sends each named person one notice listing the campaign steps that ran without waiting for them the day before.
author: openwop

chains.label: Campaign autonomy daily digest
chains.description: Send each person one notice listing yesterday's campaign steps that ran under a notify-after rule with a daily digest. Scheduled once a day per workspace by the host when a saved autonomy policy asks for a daily digest; safe to run again (one notice per person per day).
